user: Can you summarize the services provided by the Causeway VA Clinic?
assistant: The Causeway VA Clinic, located in downtown Boston, provides primary care and specialty services including mental health, laboratory services, and more. It offers quick and convenient primary care appointments, for urgent conditions same-day or next-day appointments in primary care are available. The clinic offers laboratory and pathology services  including: the study of blood, urine and other bodily fluids for illness management and testing for infectious diseases. Mental health care for common conditions such as addiction, depression, anxiety, trauma, PTSD, bipolar disorder, schizophrenia, and OCD. The mental health care services include individual and group therapy for psychiatric disorders and marriage and relationship problems. Inpatient care is available for Veterans in need of intensive treatment. We also offer telehealth visits with providers in specialties such as: Mental health, Retinal care (eye), Bariatric surgery (visit remotely with your weight-loss surgery team before and after your operation), Dermatology, Rehabilitation and Primary care.
user: Are there any other VA clinics in Boston?
assistant: Yes, there is another VA clinic in Boston called the Jamaica Plain VA Outpatient Clinic. It is located at 150 South Huntington Avenue, Jamaica Plain, MA 02130. This clinic provides primary care, mental health care, and specialty services. 
user: Is this the Clinic that can help with stuttering and problems swallowing?
assistant: The Jamaica Plain VA Outpatient Clinic provides services  that help with speech, language, fluency, voice, cognitive communication, swallowing, stuttering, and laryngectomy (surgical removal of the larynx, which contains your vocal cords).
[The End of Previous Conversation]

[The Start of Current Turn Question]
Are these clinics available 24/7 for emergencies?
[The End of Current Turn Question]

[The Start of Reference Answer]
The Causeway VA Clinic and the Jamaica Plain VA Outpatient Clinic do not provide 24/7 emergency services. The Brockton VA Medical Center is available Fri-Sun 24/7. You can also visit the Emergency Room at our West Roxbury campus 24/7. Veterans in need of emergency assistance can call the Veterans Crisis Line by dialing 988 and pressing 1 for Veteran.
[The End of Reference Answer]
